finalText:
Build clean, 0 errors now.

Two real bugs from bump, both fixed:
- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries`, new bundler shape is `retryCount`. Threw on undefined.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict check only accepted `true`/`false`, new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

Rest (DEP0142, DEP0198, etc.) just deprecation noise from the dep bump itself, not urgent.
